messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window tonight 2024-06-01T23:00Z. Targets: api:v2.4.1, runtime:v1.9.0, console:release/2024-06, router:stable-2024-05. Pin requested for api->runtime compatibility. Reply with :thumbsup: to proceed or :warning: to hold.

jess (API): quick note — api v2.4.1 switches to new header-splitting behavior. We validated locally with runtime v1.9.0 but older runtime causes 413s on large requests.

omar (runtime): confirmed. runtime v1.9.0 has the patched parser and the kernel change. If router still streams chunked bodies, we need the runtime patch.

raul (router): router stable-2024-05 hasn't flipped the new streaming-headers flag. We'll leave it as-is but need an explicit handshake test between router and api during canary.

mira (console): UI changelog is ready. Console expects the new header field names. If we pin console to release/2024-06 it's fine.

alex (release): TL;DR we need to pin runtime before api traffic hits canary. Plan: 1) rollout runtime v1.9.0 to dedicated pool (30m), 2) deploy api:v2.4.1 canary 5% for 20m, 3) check metrics, 4) promote. Rollback criteria: +5% latency P95 vs baseline OR 2% error spike.

jess (API): adding small smoke: call /health with long header payload. If 200 within 500ms proceed.

sre-oncall: will watch latency and error budgets. I set an alert: api.health.latency_p95 > baseline*1.05 for 5m -> pager.

omar (runtime): pin config snippet (apply to orch):
```yaml
pins:
  runtime: v1.9.0
  api: v2.4.1
  console: release/2024-06
  router: stable-2024-05
```

alex (release): good. Also adding manual hold command if needed: "/deploy hold --wave=evening-2"

mira (console): note — console migrations are backward compatible for 24h. If we see UI errors, console can fallback to older bindings via feature flag.

raul (router): I'll run a quick compatibility test: replay 100 sampled requests from prod between router and api with runtime v1.9.0 pinned. Expect parity. Will report within 10m.

deploy-bot: Wave evening-2 scheduled. Canary: 5% traffic to api:v2.4.1 routed to runtime pool runtime-v1-9-canary.

jess (API): :thumbsup: from me after smoke locally.

omar (runtime): :thumbsup: runtime canary pool ready.

raul (router): compatibility replay done — 0.3% difference in response headers, no 4xx/5xx. sharing logs in #eng-sre.

alex (release): proceeding with runtime pool rollout now. Starting 20:45 UTC.

sre-oncall: watching. Alerts armed.

[20m later]
deploy-bot: runtime rollout complete to 60% pool, canary pool healthy. Next: api canary 5% at 21:05 UTC.

jess (API): canary started. quick smoke: `curl -H "X-Long-Header: $(python -c 'print("a"*1500)')" https://api.internal/health` -> 200 

[10m later]
sre-oncall: metrics look stable, p95 +1.8% (within threshold). No error spike.

alex (release): promoting canary to 30% for extended validation 15m.

[15m later]
sre-oncall: watch flagged — api.tokenize.errors spiked 2.6% for 4m. Investigating traces.

jess (API): I'm seeing a small mismatch when router strips empty header values. Could be router behavior. Rolling back api canary to previous version for now.

alex (release): execute rollback. Use rollback command sample: "/rollout rollback --service=api --to=api:v2.3.8 --reason=\"tokenize error spike during header-splitting roll\""

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: api -> api:v2.3.8. Notifying dependent services.

mira (console): console unaffected. Holding console promote until we confirm router fix.

raul (router): investigating header normalization. I see router dropping empty header pairs in the streaming path. Patching now, will deploy to stable-canary in 10m.

omar (runtime): good catch. runtime isn't at fault here.

[after fix deployed]\raul (router): patch deployed to canary. Replayed tests show header parity.

jess (API): ok re-run api canary? We'll re-deploy api:v2.4.1 canary 3% then 10%.

alex (release): agreed. New plan: smaller ramp, longer watch. If alert threshold crosses again, rollback to v2.3.8.

sre-oncall: updated pager thresholds and removed hold.

deploy-bot: api:v2.4.1 canary redeployed at 22:10 UTC -> 3%.

[monitoring window]
sre-oncall: 30m monitor: p95 within +2%, error spike absent.

jess (API): promoting to 20% then 60% over next 30m.

omar (runtime): leaving runtime pin in place until full promote complete.

mira (console): safe to promote console after api reaches 60%.

alex (release): final checklist before full: release notes published, migration flag enabled, support on standby, rollback command copied to top of runbook.

jess (API): final promote done at 23:05 UTC. All services at target versions.

deploy-bot: Wave evening-2 complete. Summary: runtime v1.9.0 success, api v2.4.1 promoted after router fix. Actions: router to schedule stable rollout of header normalization, add an integration test for streaming headers.

sre-oncall: closing watch. No postmortem needed; documenting incident in release notes.

alex (release): thanks everyone. I'll update release notes and tag owners for follow-ups.

mira (console): :tada: good run.

-- end of thread --
